import sys
import math

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    if n >= 100:
        print(0)
        return
    a = [0] * 105
    b = [0] * 105
    c = [0] * 105
    d = [0] * 105
    e = [0] * 105
    idx = 1
    while idx <= n:
        a[idx] = int(next(it))
        b[idx] = int(next(it))
        c[idx] = int(next(it))
        d[idx] = int(next(it))
        e[idx] = int(next(it))
        idx += 1

    bad = set()
    i = 1
    while i <= n:
        j = 1
        while j <= n:
            k = 1
            while k <= n:
                if i != j and j != k and k != i:
                    ax = a[j] - a[i]
                    bx = b[j] - b[i]
                    cx = c[j] - c[i]
                    dx = d[j] - d[i]
                    ex = e[j] - e[i]

                    ay = a[k] - a[i]
                    by = b[k] - b[i]
                    cy = c[k] - c[i]
                    dy = d[k] - d[i]
                    ey = e[k] - e[i]

                    val = ax * ay + bx * by + cx * cy + dx * dy + ex * ey
                    m1 = ax * ax + bx * bx + cx * cx + dx * dx + ex * ex
                    m2 = ay * ay + by * by + cy * cy + dy * dy + ey * ey
                    val = val / math.sqrt(m1)
                    val = val / math.sqrt(m2)

                    if math.degrees(math.acos(val)) + 0.000000001 < 90:
                        bad.add(i)
                k += 1
            j += 1
        i += 1

    print(n - len(bad))
    p = 1
    while p <= n:
        if p not in bad:
            print(p)
        p += 1

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
